find: const identityMarker: IdentityMarkerStyle | null = opts.identityMarker ?? null;
why: The option's load-bearing default: a HUD built without `identityMarker` resolves to `null`, which every injected HUD in the suite relies on, and which draws pips with no leading mark (issue #1022). The shipped FFA `shape` reaches a real page through `loop.ts`, which resolves the flag before this option sees it (issue #922), so a `'shape'` default here would be a second source for it: every injected FFA HUD would draw the `marks` row, and so would the reversal `solid`, which `loop.ts` resolves to `null` and `??` cannot tell from an absent option. Caught by the one-rule table's FFA x null and FFA x absent cells, by the pips cases mounted with a null marker, and by the #778 case that mounts an explicitly-null HUD beside a bare `createHud(root)` and finds no svg in the strip.
killedBy: hud: identity mark in the stock strip (issue #778) draws nothing at all without the flag, and leaves the strip byte-identical
hud: identity-shaped stocks, the `marks` arm (issue #230) draws pips instead for a teams entry, and for the reversed marker (issue #1022)
hud: stock-loss cue arms (issue #230) a rematch that resets stocks upward is not a loss, and starts a new pip count
hud: stock-loss cue arms (issue #230) pips: a cue is gone once STOCK_CUE_MS has passed
hud: stock-loss cue arms (issue #230) pips: a cue still running survives the rebuild another slot's loss causes, resumed at its elapsed time
